summary: Each edition was reviewed independently against all clauses of the selected Greek. Both preserve the repentance–understanding argument, cessation of evil, lavish good, self-humbling and chastising or tormenting, the speaker changes, and the conditional promises of life. The bracketed supplement is distinguished from preserved text, and the working II.3 reading is retained with its conjectural status and alternative disclosed. The witness notes are consistent with the supplied bounded project reports and distinguish corrections, damage, and supplied material. No concrete fidelity defect was identified. Acceptance concerns this supplied text and evidence only; it does not authenticate unseen manuscripts or editions, certify exhaustive collation, or establish a unique interpretation.
